thread:
maria: Quick nsys run to investigate weird latency spikes when concurrent small batches trigger KV eviction. Dropping flags + notes below.

ashok: please paste the exact command you used. :eyes:

maria: ```
nsys profile \
  --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt \
  --output=kv-evict-2245 \
  --capture-range=nvtx:kv_start,nvtx:kv_end \
  --duration=20 \
  --sample=cpu \
  --force-overwrite \
  python -m infra.infer_runner --model x --concurrency 8 --batch_schedule dynamic
```

kevin: try bracketed osrt too, e.g. `--capture-range=osrt:begin,osrt:end` and bump sampling interval to reduce noise (or disable sampling for full timeline).

infra-bot: nsys profiler finished: kv-evict-2245.qdrep (42MB) -> /artifacts/kv-evict-2245.qdrep

maria: quick summary: saw a ~80ms gap where `kv_cache_evict` runs, followed by an attention kernel spike ~120ms. eviction seems to preempt prefetch kernels.

selena: are you using nvtx markers around the user request? bracketed captures are best for these rare evict events.

maria: yes — I NVTX push/pop around request start/end but my sample window was only 200ms so I missed the prefetch that happens slightly earlier. Extended to 4s and now we see prefetch + eviction overlap.

ashok: recommended flags for this pattern: `--trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt` + sampling disabled or long interval to avoid aliasing. Example: `nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --sample=none --output=... --capture-range=nvtx:start,nvtx:stop --stop-delay=2`

kevin: alternatively capture full kernel timeline (no sampling) for a short period, then run a longer bracketed sampled capture to get statistical view. Both are cheap if you keep duration small.

maria: experiment result: when I forced the batcher to prefer larger batches, eviction events dropped ~70% but p99 for short prompts increased. classic tradeoff. :thinking_face:

selena: can you paste the small timeline snippet (time | kernel | dur)?

maria: ```
0.001s  | prefetch_kernel        | 12.4ms
0.020s  | kv_cache_evict         | 82.1ms  <-- overlaps with next
0.105s  | attention_fwd          | 120.9ms
0.230s  | postprocess            | 3.2ms
```

ashok: I'll run a follow-up capture with your config + `--sample=none` and compare. /assign @ashok

kevin: also check GPU busy % and OSRT wait events in the trace to see if CPU stalls line up with eviction.

maria: thanks — will upload the full qdrep and a perfetto timeline link once I have both captures. :thumbsup:
